outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Tmprss11b normalized counts (mean ± SD) across six mouse models, and individual data points are overlaid as colored dots (red/blue/orange) for each biological replicate.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental workflow, not a data plot.
Panel C shows representative MRI photographs of tumors, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
